description: This file defines authentication-related service functions for user signup, login, and current user retrieval using JWT tokens, integrated with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: signup_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password after ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: str login_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials and issues a JWT token.

methods.name: get_current_user( db: Session = Depends(get_db), credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(bearer_scheme) )
methods.description: FastAPI dependency function to retrieve and validate the current user from a JWT token.
